design.analysis: Exact full-grid finite counts and profile/domain/case tables; paired differences and equal-profile means over the full 64-profile grid. No population confidence intervals, bootstrap, p-values, task generalization, or autonomous-agent benchmark claim. No multiplicity-based selection; all planned factors/endpoints retained.
design.authorship: Explicit controlled case generation by the study developers; not independently authored, externally validated, or held-out tasks.
design.failures: Exclusive first run; no retry/resume/replacement or exclusions. Keep every scheduled error, journal, compressed raw record and SQLite snapshot. A collection interruption remains incomplete; repair requires a disclosed new protocol.

hypotheses.one_final_read: A definite correct global-state claim in 1/64 profiles per domain: all three delays zero.
hypotheses.physical: Every completed arm has one correct committed effect by D, persistent through S, with no duplicate/unwanted event and no dispatch differences.
hypotheses.polling_reference_state: A definite correct global-state claim in 27/64 profiles per domain: lag<=80 and both window ends<=210. Conditions intersect at the available read time, not independently sampled probabilities.
hypotheses.response_retry: The response-based policy reports success on the immediate ACK in all profiles; this is not evidence-grounded verification. The uniform-positive design cannot measure its false-success risk.

limitations: Motivated after observing the original study; no confirmatory claim about that earlier negative finding.
Polling availability benefit, if observed, is shared by the unchanged strong reference and state-only controller; no framework superiority or recovery-action benefit follows.
Admitted source, exhaustive history, commit watermarks and provider guarantees are application assumptions.
No false-ACK, late commit, wrong payload, external actor, removal, adversarial provenance or task-population diversity in this controlled grid.
Finite safety horizon cannot establish unbounded exactly-once behavior.
One seed per deterministic controlled cell; three domains repeat the same mechanism, not independent population samples.
design.matching: One seed (0), every profile in all three domains and all five unchanged original policies. Method order rotates by case index. Same stable logical identity/provider semantics/budget ceilings; realized read histories may differ.
design.motivation: The completed and audited original study did not expose an incremental polling benefit. This follow-up deliberately intervenes on evidence availability; it supplements and does not replace that original negative result.
design.primary: Operational safe-recovery over every scheduled slot, as in the original study. Failed slots contribute zero operational success; missing physical/semantic outcomes remain unavailable. The uniform-safe design is expected to show no primary improvement.
design.secondary: Correct definite global-state reporting yield, original/recovery completion, action-linked reporting, harmful effects, and charged reads/dispatches. Endpoint definitions and original summarizer are unchanged.
design.type: Post hoc motivated, prospectively frozen controlled availability factorial follow-up
